name: tpl-existence-2-goal
task: Open the door. Pick up the box in the other room.

value.feedback: NO CHANGES NEEDED: Existence(door_open) and Existence(target_picked_up) are both hard and each matches one of the two independent commands. The sentences have no order word, so no Precedence is added, and the environment already forces the door to open before the box room is reached.

texts: Open the door: the locked door is open at some step of the episode.
Pick up the box in the other room: the agent carries the target box at some step of the episode.
machine:
